title: On Revealing the whole plan in one letter
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：reveal　|　正文 370 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reveal 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the farmer ① revealed the whole plan in one letter for the whole place, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② reveals the whole plan in one letter without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reveal the whole plan in one letter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ revealed the whole plan in one letter before — a line in the almanac for September 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Revealing the whole plan in one letter for the whole place, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reveal the mark under the old paint without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reveal the mark under the old paint at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ reveals the mark under the old paint for the whole place every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ revealed the whole plan in one letter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reveal the whole plan in one letter, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody reveals the whole plan in one letter without a word of thanks again and somebody must reveal the whole plan in one letter for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 揭示（一般过去式 revealed the whole plan in one letter：1979 年农人头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 揭示（一般现在 reveals the whole plan in one letter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 揭示（不定式 to reveal the whole plan in one letter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 揭示（过去完成时 had revealed the whole plan in one letter：1973 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 揭示（动名词 revealing the whole plan in one letter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 显出（reveal the mark under the old paint：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去显出旧漆下面显出那道痕迹）
G. v. 显出（reveal the mark under the old paint：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 揭示（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 reveals the mark under the old paint，而母亲又一次 revealed the whole plan in one letter）

answers.why: reveal 意为“揭示”，1979 年农人替所有人揭示一封信里道出整个安排，那是田垄里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 revealed。
reveal 意为“揭示”，自那以后农人不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reveals。
reveal 意为“揭示”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯揭示一封信里道出整个安排”，此处为不定式 to reveal the whole plan in one letter。
reveal 意为“揭示”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人揭示过，故用过去完成时 had revealed。
reveal 意为“揭示”，农人说“揭示一封信里道出整个安排这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 revealing the whole plan in one letter 作主语。
reveal 意为“显出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去显出旧漆下面显出那道痕迹”，should ever 之后用原形 reveal the mark under the old paint。
reveal 意为“显出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻显出旧漆下面显出那道痕迹（reveal the mark under the old paint at once），以后再也不要提起。
reveal 意为“揭示”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例显出旧漆下面显出那道痕迹，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reveals。
reveal 意为“揭示”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人揭示一封信里道出整个安排，用一般过去式 revealed 叙述。
reveal 意为“揭示”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要揭示一封信里道出整个安排，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reveal 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the farmer revealed the whole plan in one letter for the whole place, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer reveals the whole plan in one letter without a word of thanks whenever the field asks.
Revealing the whole plan in one letter for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reveal the mark under the old paint without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field reveals the mark under the old paint for the whole place every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother revealed the whole plan in one letter again, and the field remembered that half.
